summary: While the convention moves around them, workers keep a card file of delegates up to date.
realLife: Vogelsinger remembered colleagues maintaining delegate cards opposite her convention desk.
gates: The campaign uses a paper delegate file.
inGame: needs: a convention delegate file with dated changes and a responsible worker.

turns.what: A worker pencils in a reported change and leaves the old entry legible.
turns.pulledBy: The delegate has yet to confirm what a visitor reported.
turns.writesBack: The card distinguishes the pending report from the last confirmed entry.

turns.what: The night shift reconciles cards after the delegations check in.
turns.pulledBy: Several arrivals came while the desk was closed.
turns.writesBack: The file gains confirmation times for those delegates.
